data_origin: Actual published airway RNA-seq gene counts and sample annotations, preserved from Bioconductor airway1.32.0, release3.23, original63677genes by8samples. The public counts are an exact4096gene computational panel selected solely by SHA256(gene_ID), independent of counts, treatment and outcomes; no counts transformed and all selected rows including all-zero rows retained. Provenance, original RData, DESCRIPTION, license texts and reproducible extraction are retained in the revision airway_snapshot resource. The controlled methods-audit questions and focal choices are benchmark construction, not conclusions attributed to the original authors.
scope: Four donor-derived airway smooth-muscle cell lines, each with one untreated and one treated library. Cell line is the paired biological unit; eight libraries are not eight independent donors. Count columns and annotation rows deliberately have different orders and must be matched by exact sample_id. The labels trt/untrt refer to the published dexamethasone condition. No patient clinical outcome, absolute RNA-per-cell change or functional intervention is inferred.
count_model: Use the registered PyDESeq2 negative-binomial count-model operation on ALL4096provided gene rows. Paired analysis has additive categorical design factors cell and condition, signed contrast[condition,trt,untrt]. Request fit_type=parametric,cooks_filter=true; preserve the disclosed actual dispersion trend/fallback, no independent filtering, no count replacement and no LFC shrinkage. The unpaired comparator uses condition alone on the same complete panel. Then fit four leave-one-cell-line-out analyses: remove BOTH samples for that cell, retain all4096genes and use the paired cell+condition design on the remaining six samples. Do not preselect focal genes before normalization/dispersion fitting, alter count values or fit individual genes as unrelated normal-mean tests. Numerical cache use is allowed; it is not an independent experiment.
analysis_names: Use paired,unpaired and leave_CELLID for each literal cell value in metadata. Within each analysis, an eligible hypothesis has testable=true, finite unadjusted p_value and converged fitted LFC as reported by the operation. Null/untested rows remain in the4096row result and are not assigned p=0, log2FC=0 or evidence of no change. Report each analysis eligible count.
complete_family_discovery: For the paired result, apply BOTH BH and BY correction to its ENTIRE eligible gene family before looking at the focal panel. Call significance at adjusted p<=0.05. Report complete-family rejection counts and the focal significant gene IDs under each rule. BH relies on valid marginal p-values plus its dependence assumptions; its calculated rejection set is not proof of FDR control under arbitrary gene dependence. BY addresses arbitrary dependence given valid p-values, and both remain conditional on the fitted approximate Wald testing model. Do not adjust only eight focal p-values, include untestable zeros, use the original63677gene universe, or claim this4096panel is a full-transcriptome analysis.
simultaneous_effect_inference: For effect-size classification use only paired and its four leave-one-cell-line-out fits, excluding the unpaired comparator. Let M be the SUM of eligible gene counts across these five analyses, retaining each gene-analysis hypothesis separately even though analyses overlap. Let z=Phi^{-1}(1-0.05/(2*M)). For every eligible row use the model-based approximate simultaneous interval[log2FC-z*SE,log2FC+z*SE]. Bonferroni does not require independent overlapping analyses, but approximate Wald marginal validity remains an assumption. Fixed practical threshold is one log2unit, corresponding to a twofold relative expression ratio. Classify a focal gene in the full paired fit as increase_gt_twofold if its interval lower bound is STRICTLY greater than1; decrease_gt_twofold if upper bound is STRICTLY below-1; within_twofold if BOTH interval bounds lie STRICTLY inside(-1,1); otherwise unresolved. A null/untestable focal row is untestable. Boundary equality is unresolved. An interval entirely inside(-1,1) can coexist with rejection of the exact zero-effect null; practical equivalence does not mean mathematically zero expression change.
leave_one_out_robustness: A focal large-effect claim is robust only if its full paired fit AND all four leave-one-cell-line-out fits have the SAME direction-specific large-effect classification under the single simultaneous z above. A null row or crossing of the practical boundary in any fit prevents that robust claim. Do not combine overlapping-fit p-values as independent experiments; do not call a gene robust because all fitted point estimates have the same sign.
focal_selection_scope: The benchmark authors selected this small focal audit set after exploratory fits to expose different statistical decisions. It is not an independently prespecified confirmatory biological panel. Full-family corrections and simultaneous intervals are calculated before focal extraction; no biological mechanism, gene-function claim or newly confirmed target is scored.

interpretation_proposals.A: A statistically detectable nonzero relative effect may still lie within a declared practical-equivalence region.
interpretation_proposals.B: A null/untestable result is positive evidence of exactly zero expression change.
interpretation_proposals.C: Removing a cell-line pair in each sensitivity analysis preserves the paired observational structure, but overlapping fits are not independent studies.
interpretation_proposals.D: A BH rejection set automatically has an arbitrary-dependence FDR guarantee for real gene counts regardless of the Wald model.
interpretation_proposals.E: A paired log2fold change is a normalized relative count-model effect and does not by itself establish an absolute RNA-per-cell change.
interpretation_proposals.F: The eight sequencing libraries represent eight independent donor biological units.
interpretation_proposals.G: The complete eligible testing family must be corrected before selecting this focal report.
interpretation_proposals.H: Agreement of large fitted point estimates alone establishes robustness of their interval-based practical-effect claims.

reporting: Return biological_unit_count; paired_design_rank_and_residual_df as[rank,df]; eligible_gene_counts_by_analysis keyed exactly as above; paired_complete_family_rejection_counts keyed bh,by; focal_significant_gene_ids_by_correction keyed bh,by with sorted lists; simultaneous_effect_family_size; simultaneous_normal_critical_value; focal_paired_log2_fold_changes keyed by every focal ID, null if untestable; focal_paired_practical_effect_class keyed by every focal ID using the exact labels; focal_robust_large_effect_gene_ids sorted; valid_interpretation_proposal_ids. Counts, IDs, categories and nulls exact. Fold changes absolute1e-5 plus relative1e-5; z absolute1e-7 plus relative1e-7. Do not dump thousands of backend rows into the final answer; use full task-local model and correction artifacts for analysis and report these compact scientific decisions.
